Rashi on Bava Metzia 43b:10:1.english: There - To the Land of Israel.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 43b:10:2.hebrew: אקיף - הרבה את הדרך וסבב דרך ארוכה על דבר זה, ללכת דרך מעלת של הר צור, מקום שר' יעקב שם, ובעי מינה מה שמע מר' יוחנן רבו על כך. כל מהלך דרך ארוכה במקום שיש קצרה — מקיף הוא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 43b:10:2.english: Take a circuitous [route] - Lengthen the journey and go around [by] a long road for this matter, to go by way of the ascent of Mount Tyre, the place where Rabbi Yaakov is [located], and ask of him what he heard from Rabbi Yochanan his teacher regarding this. Anyone who travels a long road where there is a short [one] is [called] one who goes around (makif).

Rashi on Bava Metzia 43b:12:1.hebrew: אי נמי דהדרה לדוכתה - להכי אשמועינן לעולם, לומר שאם החזירה למקומה לאחר ששלח בה יד ונשברה באונס, אף בזו הלכה כר"ע, דאמר לעיל גבי גנב טלה מן העדר, צריך דעת בעלי':
Rashi on Bava Metzia 43b:12:1.english: Or alternatively, where he returned it to its place - For this [purpose] [Rabbi Yoḥanan] taught us "always," to say that if he returned it to its place after misappropriating it and it broke through an unavoidable accident, in this [case] as well the halakha is in accordance with Rabbi Akiva, who said above regarding one who steals a lamb from the flock [that] the knowledge of the owners is required.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 43b:12:2.hebrew: ורבא אמר הלכה כב"ה - כשעת גזילה, ואנן כרבא עבדינן, דהוה ליה בתראה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 43b:12:2.english: And Rava says: The halakha is in accordance with Beit Hillel - [that he pays according to its value] as of the time of the robbery. And we act in accordance with Rava, for he is the later [authority].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 43b:13:1.english: One who intends to misappropriate - He said before witnesses, "I will take so-and-so's deposit for myself."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 43b:13:2.hebrew: חייב - באונסים מהיום והלאה, אם נאנס, חייב באחריות:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 43b:13:2.english: Liable - For unavoidable accidents from today onward; if it suffers an unavoidable accident, he is liable for [its] responsibility.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 43b:13:3.english: He tilted the barrel - It is an independent matter.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 43b:13:4.english: And it broke - After some time.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 43b:13:5.hebrew: אינו משלם אלא רביעית - דשליחות יד אינו מתחייב באונסין עד שיסמוך או יגביה, דהוי קנייה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 43b:13:5.english: He pays only [for] a quarter[-log] - For [in the case of] misappropriation, one does not become liable for unavoidable accidents until he supports [i.e., draws] or lifts [it], which constitutes an act of acquisition.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 43b:13:6.hebrew: הגביהה ונטל - דהוי קנייה בהגבהתה וחסרון מנטילת רביעית, חייב באונסיה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 43b:13:6.english: He lifted it and took - Since there is acquisition by lifting it and a diminution from taking the quarter[-log], he is liable for unavoidable accidents [that befall it].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 43b:1:1.hebrew: אלא פשיטא כשעת הוצאה מבית בעלים - כשעת הגזילה. וביתר פליגי, דקאמרי ב"ש: אם הוקרה, ילקה לשלם כשעת הוצאה מן העולם, ובית הלל אמרי כשעת הוצאה מבית הבעלים:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 43b:1:1.english: Rather, [it is] obvious [that it means] as of the time of removal from the owner's house - [That is,] as of the time of the robbery. And they disagree regarding an increase [in value], as Beit Shammai say: If it appreciated, he is penalized to pay as of the time of removal from the world, whereas Beit Hillel say [he pays] as of the time of removal from the owner's house.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 43b:1:2.hebrew: כי פליגי בחסר - וקאמרי ב"ה כשעת הוצאה מן העולם. ודקא קשיא לך, כל הגזלנין משלמים כשעת הגזילה? אי בגזילה ממש, דגזלה מעיקרא, ה"נ; אבל הכא, דבהיתרא אתא לידי' ומשום שליחות יד קמחייבת ליה, בהא פליגי:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 43b:1:2.english: When they disagree, [it is] in [the case of] a decrease - And Beit Hillel say [that he pays] in accordance with [its value at] the time of [its] removal from the world. And as for what is difficult for you — [namely, that] all robbers pay [according to the value] at the time of the robbery: if [it were a case of] actual robbery, where he robbed it from the outset, indeed so; however, here, where it came into his hand permissibly and you are obligating him on account of misappropriation, about this they disagree.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 43b:2:1.hebrew: ב"ש סברי שליחות יד אינה צריכה חסרון - ומששלח בה יד, אע"פ שלא חסרה, הויא גזילה וקמה ברשותיה, וכשהוזלה ברשותו הוזלה. ואם היתה בעין, אומר לו "הרי שלך לפניך"; עכשיו שהוציאה, משלם כשעת שליחות יד:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 43b:2:1.english: Beit Shammai hold [that] misappropriation does not require loss - And once he laid a hand on it, even though it did not diminish, it is [deemed] robbery and stands in his possession, and when it depreciated in value, it depreciated in his possession. And if it were [still] intact, he [could] say to him, "Here is yours before you"; [but] now that he has used it up, he pays according to [its value at] the time of misappropriation.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 43b:3:1.english: But that which Rava said - Earlier in our sugya (Bava Metzia 41b).

Rashi on Bava Metzia 43b:3:2.english: Misappropriation does not require loss - For [Rava] said: "Lest you say misappropriation [requires loss], etc."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 43b:5:1.hebrew: הא דאמר רבא - בהמוכר את הספינה (ב"ב דף פח.):
Rashi on Bava Metzia 43b:5:1.english: That which Rava said - in [the chapter] HaMokher et HaSefinah (Bava Batra 88a).

Rashi on Bava Metzia 43b:5:2.hebrew: שואל שלא מדעת לרבנן גזלן הוא - גבי שולח את בנו אצל חנוני, דפליגי רבנן ור' יהודה, ואוקי רבא פלוגתייהו בשואל שלא מדעת, ואמר דלרבנן גזלן הוי. ומדאוקי רבא לרבנן בהכי, סבירא ליה לדידיה גזלן הוי, ואהדר לאוקמי מילתיה כרבנן, דהלכתא כרבים:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 43b:5:2.english: One who borrows without knowledge, according to the Rabbis, is a robber - Regarding [the case of] one who sends his son to a shopkeeper, where the Rabbis and R. Yehuda disagree, and Rava established their dispute as [concerning] one who borrows without [the owner's] knowledge, and said that according to the Rabbis he is a robber. And since Rava established [the view of] the Rabbis thus, he himself holds [that] he is a robber, and [the Gemara] sought to establish his statement in accordance with the Rabbis, because the law follows the majority.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 43b:5:3.english: Shall we say like Beit Shammai - [Meaning, Rava] stated it.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 43b:5:4.hebrew: אלא הכא בשבח גזילה פליגי - והאי חסר ויתר דמתני', לאו ביוקרא וזולא, אלא במאי דחסרה — דהיינו גיזות — ובמאי שהותירה, כגון אם נתעברה אצלו; דב"ש סברי: הכל ישלם, כר"מ דברייתא, וב"ה כרבי יהוד', כשעת הוצאה מבית הבעלים:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 43b:5:4.english: Rather, here they disagree regarding the enhancement of stolen property - And this "decrease and increase" of our Mishnah is not [referring] to appreciation and depreciation [in market value], rather to what it lost — namely, shearings — and to what it gained, such as if it became pregnant while in his possession; for Beit Shammai hold [that] he must pay everything, like R' Meir of the Baraita, and Beit Hillel [hold] like Rabbi Yehudah, [that he pays] as of the time of removal from the owner's house.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 43b:7:1.hebrew: דיקא נמי - דבגיזות וולדות פליגי, דקתני לשון חסר ויתר, ולא קתני לשון זול ויוקר:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 43b:7:1.english: [The language] is also precise - That they disagree regarding shearings and offspring, as [the mishnah] teaches the expression "decrease and increase," and does not teach the expression "cheapness and dearness."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 43b:8:1.hebrew: ומודה ר"ע במקום שיש עדים - כמה היתה שוה ביום שגזלה וראו שגזלה הימנו, דמשלם כשעת הגזילה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 43b:8:1.english: And Rabbi Akiva concedes where there are witnesses - [as to] how much it was worth on the day he robbed it and they saw that he robbed it from him, that he pays according to [its value at] the time of the robbery.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 43b:8:2.english: What is the reason of Rabbi Akiva - Who says, "[in accordance with] the time of the claim."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 43b:8:3.hebrew: דאמר קרא ביום אשמתו - בדמים של אותו יום שהוא מתחייב לו. והיכא דתבעו והודה, דעל פיו הוא מתחייב, העמדתו בדין והודאתו הוא יום אשמתו. אבל אם יש עדים, משעה שראוהו שגזלה הוא אשם לו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 43b:8:3.english: For the verse states, "on the day of his guilt" - [He pays] the monetary value of that day on which he becomes liable to him. And where [the owner] claimed [it] from him and he confessed, such that he becomes liable by his own admission, his standing in court and his confession is "the day of his guilt." However, if there are witnesses, from the moment they saw him rob it, he is guilty toward him.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 43b:13:1.hebrew: החושב לשלוח יד - הך מחשבה הוי דבור, כדיליף מ"על כל דבר". וכן מחשבת פגול נמי הוי בדבור ולא בלב, כדמוכח בפרק ב' דזבחים (דף ל.), ובפ"ק דמנחות (דף ג:), ובפרק תמיד נשחט (פסחים דף סג.), ובפרק הנזקין (גיטין דף נד:), ובמקומות אחרים פירשתי:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 43b:13:1.english: One who intends to misappropriate - This intention is [expressed through] speech, as [the Gemara] derives from [the verse] "for every matter [devar] [of trespass]" (Exodus 22:8). And similarly, an intention of piggul [disqualifying a sacrifice through improper intent] is also [expressed] through speech and not [merely] in the heart, as is proven in the second chapter of Zevachim (30a), and in the first chapter of Menachot (3b), and in the chapter Tamid Nishchat (Pesachim 63a), and in the chapter HaNizakin (Gittin 54b), and in other places I have explained [this].

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 43b:1:1.hebrew: לימא רבה דאמר כב"ש - וא"ת: לוקי פלוגתייהו באתבר ממילא, ורבה כב"ה? וי"ל: דא"כ לא הוו פליגי בית שמאי:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 43b:1:1.english: Shall we say that Rabba stated [his opinion] in accordance with Beit Shammai - And if you will say: Let us establish their dispute [as referring to a case] where it broke on its own, and Rabba [holds] like Beit Hillel? And one can say [in answer]: Because if so, Beit Shammai would not have disagreed.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 43b:2:1.hebrew: בית שמאי סברי שליחות יד אינה צריכה חסרון - וא"ת: א"כ, תרי בבי — הך דהכא וסיפא דהחושב לשלוח יד — למה לי? וי"ל: דסיפא אשמועי' דלב"ש אפילו דבור בלא משיכה חייב, והך דהכא אשמועינן דלב"ה צריכה חסרון:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 43b:2:1.english: Beit Shammai hold [that] misappropriation does not require loss - And if you say: If so, why do I need two clauses — this one here and the latter clause of [the Mishnah stating] "One who intends to misappropriate"? And one can answer that the latter clause teaches us that according to Beit Shammai, even speech without pulling [the deposit] renders [him] liable, and this [clause] here teaches us that according to Beit Hillel, [misappropriation] requires loss.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 43b:5:1.hebrew: אלא הא דאמר רבא שואל שלא מדעת גזלן הוי - אומר ר"ת דגרסינן בכל הני "רבא", דהך דשואל ע"כ רבא הוי, דקאמר בתר רבה ורב יוסף בהמוכר הספינה (ב"ב דף פח.), ומדהאי רבא — כולהו נמי רבא; דאי לאו הכי לא פריך מידי, דמצי לאוקומה פלוגתיה כחד מהנך פלוגתי' דלעיל:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 43b:5:1.english: "Rather, [concerning] this that Rava said: One who borrows without permission is [considered] a robber" - Rabbeinu Tam says that in all of these [passages] we read "Rava." For this [statement] regarding one who borrows [without permission] is perforce Rava, since it is stated after Rabbah and Rav Yosef in [the chapter] HaMokher Et HaSefinah (Bava Batra 88a). And since this one is Rava, all of them are also Rava; for if it were not so, [the Gemara] would not have raised any objection, since one could have established his dispute in accordance with one of those disputes [mentioned] above.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 43b:6:1.hebrew: משלם אותה ואת גיזותיה ואת ולדותיה, דברי ר"מ, רבי יהודה אומר גזלה חוזרת בעיניה - וא"ת: הא דתנן בפרק הגוזל קמא (ב"ק דף ק:): "הנותן צמר לצבע לצבוע לו אדום וצבעו שחור — אם השבח יתר על הוצאה, נותן לו היציאה, ואם הוצאה יתירה על השבח, נותן לו השבח, דברי רבי יהודה; ר"מ אומר: אין נותן לו אלא דמי צמרו בלבד", אלמא סברתם הפוכות! ותירץ ר"ת: דהכא גבי גזילה סבר ר"מ שינוי אינו קונה, משום דקנסא קניס במזיד, אבל בלצבוע לו אדום דשוגג — לא קניס, והכי איתא בהגוזל. ור' יהודה דסבר הכא דשינוי קונה, היינו משום דמתכוין לקנות בשינוי, אבל צבעו שחור — אין מתכוין לקנותו בכך:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 43b:6:1.english: [The robber] pays [for] it and its fleece and its offspring; [this is] the statement of Rabbi Meir. Rabbi Yehuda says: The stolen [property] returns in its [current] state - And if you ask: [What about] that which we learned in a Mishnah in the chapter HaGozel Kamma (Bava Kamma 100b): "If one gives wool to a dyer to dye it red for him, and he dyed it black — if the appreciation exceeds the expense, he gives him the expense; and if the expense exceeds the appreciation, he gives him the appreciation; [this is] the statement of Rabbi Yehuda. Rabbi Meir says: He gives him only the value of his wool" — thus their opinions are reversed! And Rabbeinu Tam answered: Here, regarding robbery, Rabbi Meir holds [that] a change does not acquire, because he penalizes an intentional [wrongdoer]; however, in [the case of] dyeing it red, which is unintentional, he does not penalize, and so it is [stated] in [the chapter] HaGozel. And Rabbi Yehuda, who holds here that a change acquires, that is because [the robber] intends to acquire through the change; however, [where the dyer] dyed it black, he does not intend to acquire it thereby.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 43b:8:1.hebrew: ר"ע אומר כשעת התביעה - תימה: מאי קסבר? אי קסבר שינוי קונה — למה ישלם השבח כשעת התביעה? הלא בשעת גזיזה קנאה, ואם הגדילה רחל או הגזיזה ונתייקרה, לא ישלם אלא כמו ששוה רחל בשעת גזיזה. ואי קסבר שינוי אינו קונה — א"כ, כשגזזה אחר התביעה נמי יהא הכל לנגזל, דבמאי קנה? ועוד: דקאמר "ומודה ר"ע במקום שיש עדים" בשעת שליחות יד שישלם כאותה שעה — במאי קנה? והלא אכתי אפילו שינוי ליכא, וגם כי יגזזנה שינוי לא יקנה! ועוד: למאן מודה? הלא בין לב"ש בין לב"ה לא קנאה בשעת שליחות יד עד שעת שינוי! ועוד: דשמואל ור' יוחנן פסקו כר"ע בשמעתין, ובהגוזל קמא (ב"ק דף צד:) אית להו דשינוי קונה. לכך נראה: לב"ש דאמרי "ילקה בחסר ויתר", מיירי אף ביוקרא וזולא — דאם הוקרה משלם כשעת הוצאה מן העולם, ואם הוזלה משלם כשעת הגזלה; וב"ה לא פליגי נמי בהא, והיינו כרבה. אלא ב"ש מיירי נמי בשינוי, כדקאמר "דיקא נמי מדלא קתני בזול וביוקר", ובהא פליגי ב"ה — דשינוי קונה. ור"ע פליג אזול ויוקר, דאמר משלם כשעת התביעה בין הוזל ובין הוקר:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 43b:8:1.english: Rabbi Akiva says: In accordance with [the value at] the time of the claim - This is astonishing: what does he hold? If he holds that a change [in the object] acquires [it for the robber], why should he pay [for] the increase [in value] according to the time of the claim? Surely at the time of shearing he acquired it, so if the ewe grew or the shearing [occurred] and it became more expensive, he should pay only what the ewe was worth at the time of shearing. And if he holds that a change does not acquire [it], if so, even when he sheared it after the claim, everything should belong to the robbed party, for through what did he acquire [it]? And furthermore, regarding what [the Gemara] says: "And Rabbi Akiva concedes where there are witnesses" at the time of the misappropriation that he must pay according to that time — through what did he acquire [it]? Surely there is not even a change yet, and even when he shears it, a change will not acquire [it]! And furthermore, to whom does he concede? Surely according to both Beit Shammai and Beit Hillel, he did not acquire it at the time of misappropriation until the time of the change! And furthermore, Shmuel and Rabbi Yochanan ruled in accordance with Rabbi Akiva in our sugya, yet in [the chapter] HaGozel Kamma (Bava Kamma 94b) they hold that a change acquires! Therefore, it seems [that] according to Beit Shammai, who say "he suffers the loss whether it decreases or increases," they are speaking also of a rise or drop in price — that if it became more expensive, he pays according to the time of its removal from the world, and if it became cheaper, he pays according to the time of the robbery; and Beit Hillel do not disagree with this either, and this is in accordance with Rabbah. Rather, Beit Shammai are also speaking of a change, as [the Gemara] says: "This is also exact, since it does not teach 'in cheapness and in dearness,'" and it is regarding this that Beit Hillel disagree — [holding] that a change acquires. And Rabbi Akiva disagrees regarding a drop or rise in price, for he says he pays according to the time of the claim, whether it became cheaper or more expensive.
